About
Ralip Pranaja Violincello

Hi! My name is Ralip Pranaja Violincello, and I am a Full-Stack Developer. I began delving into the world of programming while studying Computer Engineering at Universitas Muhammadiyah PKU Surakarta.

From Indonesia To International, I am always working hard to make my dream come true. I have experience with a variety of technologies and frameworks, including Nuxt 3, Vue.js, React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and MySQL.
